MATCH p=(a:Issue)-[rs*1..5]-(b:Issue)
WHERE a.issueKey<b.issueKey AND all(r IN rs WHERE type(r)<>'HAS_PARENT' AND r.linkId IS NOT NULL)
AND size(apoc.coll.toSet(nodes(p)))=size(nodes(p))
WITH p,a,b,nodes(p) AS ns
WHERE all(n IN ns WHERE EXISTS{(n)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(:Person)} AND EXISTS{(n)-[:IN_PROJECT]->(:Project)})
AND all(i IN range(0,size(ns)-2) WHERE ns[i].issueKey<>ns[i+1].issueKey AND NOT EXISTS{(ns[i])-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(x)<-[:ASSIGNED_TO]-(ns[i+1])})
AND NOT EXISTS{(a)-[r]-(n:Issue) WHERE r.linkId IS NOT NULL AND NOT n IN ns AND EXISTS{(n)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(y)} AND NOT EXISTS{(a)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(y)}}
AND NOT EXISTS{(b)-[r]-(n:Issue) WHERE r.linkId IS NOT NULL AND NOT n IN ns AND EXISTS{(n)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(y)} AND NOT EXISTS{(b)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(y)}}
RETURN [n IN ns | n.issueKey] AS path, size(ns)-1 AS hops

MATCH p=(a:Issue)-[rs*1..5]-(b:Issue)
WHERE a.issueKey<b.issueKey AND all(r IN rs WHERE type(r)<>'HAS_PARENT' AND r.linkId IS NOT NULL)
WITH p,a,b,nodes(p) AS ns
WHERE size(apoc.coll.toSet(ns))=size(ns)
WITH p,a,b,ns,[n IN ns | head([(n)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(x)|x.personKey])] AS as
WHERE all(x IN as WHERE x IS NOT NULL) AND all(i IN range(0,size(ns)-2) WHERE as[i]<>as[i+1])
AND NOT EXISTS{(a)-[r]-(n:Issue)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(y) WHERE r.linkId IS NOT NULL AND NOT n IN ns AND y.personKey<>as[0]}
AND NOT EXISTS{(b)-[r]-(n:Issue)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(y) WHERE r.linkId IS NOT NULL AND NOT n IN ns AND y.personKey<>as[-1]}
RETURN [n IN ns | n.issueKey] AS path, size(ns)-1 AS hops

MATCH p=(a:Issue)-[rs*1..5]-(b:Issue)
WHERE a.issueKey<b.issueKey AND all(r IN rs WHERE type(r)<>'HAS_PARENT' AND r.linkId IS NOT NULL)
WITH p,a,b,nodes(p) AS ns
WHERE all(i IN range(0,size(ns)-1) WHERE all(j IN range(i+1,size(ns)-1) WHERE ns[i]<>ns[j]))
WITH p,a,b,ns,[n IN ns | head([(n)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(x)|x.personKey])] AS asg
WHERE all(x IN asg WHERE x IS NOT NULL) AND all(i IN range(0,size(ns)-2) WHERE asg[i]<>asg[i+1])
AND NOT EXISTS{(a)-[r]-(n:Issue)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(y) WHERE r.linkId IS NOT NULL AND NOT n IN ns AND y.personKey<>asg[0]}
AND NOT EXISTS{(b)-[r]-(n:Issue)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(y) WHERE r.linkId IS NOT NULL AND NOT n IN ns AND y.personKey<>asg[-1]}
RETURN [n IN ns | n.issueKey] AS path, size(ns)-1 AS hops

MATCH p=(a:Issue)((x:Issue)-[r]-(y:Issue) WHERE r.linkId IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS{(x)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(u),(y)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(v) WHERE u<>v}){1,5}(b:Issue)
WHERE a.issueKey<b.issueKey
WITH p,a,b,nodes(p) AS ns
WHERE all(i IN range(0,size(ns)-1) WHERE all(j IN range(i+1,size(ns)-1) WHERE ns[i]<>ns[j]))
AND NOT EXISTS{(a)-[r]-(n:Issue)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(y) WHERE r.linkId IS NOT NULL AND NOT n IN ns AND NOT EXISTS{(a)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(y)}}
AND NOT EXISTS{(b)-[r]-(n:Issue)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(y) WHERE r.linkId IS NOT NULL AND NOT n IN ns AND NOT EXISTS{(b)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(y)}}
RETURN [n IN ns | n.issueKey] AS path, size(ns)-1 AS hops

MATCH p=(a:Issue)((x:Issue)-[r]-(y:Issue) WHERE r.linkId IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS{(x)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(u),(y)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(v) WHERE u<>v}){1,5}(b:Issue)
WHERE a.issueKey<b.issueKey
WITH p,a,b,nodes(p) AS ns
WHERE all(i IN range(0,size(ns)-1) WHERE all(j IN range(i+1,size(ns)-1) WHERE ns[i]<>ns[j]))
AND NOT EXISTS{(a)-[r2]-(n:Issue)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(q) WHERE r2.linkId IS NOT NULL AND NOT n IN ns AND NOT EXISTS{(a)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(q)}}
AND NOT EXISTS{(b)-[r3]-(m:Issue)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(q2) WHERE r3.linkId IS NOT NULL AND NOT m IN ns AND NOT EXISTS{(b)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(q2)}}
RETURN [n IN ns | n.issueKey] AS path, size(ns)-1 AS hops

MATCH p=(a:Issue)((x:Issue)-[r]-(y:Issue) WHERE r.linkId IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS{(x)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(u),(y)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(v) WHERE u<>v}){1,5}(b:Issue)
WHERE a.issueKey<b.issueKey
WITH p,a,b,nodes(p) AS ns
WHERE all(i IN range(0,size(ns)-1) WHERE all(j IN range(i+1,size(ns)-1) WHERE ns[i]<>ns[j]))
AND NOT EXISTS{(a)-[r2]-(n:Issue)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(q) WHERE r2.linkId IS NOT NULL AND NOT n IN ns AND NOT EXISTS{(a)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(q)}}
AND NOT EXISTS{(b)-[r3]-(m:Issue)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(q2) WHERE r3.linkId IS NOT NULL AND NOT m IN ns AND NOT EXISTS{(b)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(q2)}}
RETURN DISTINCT [n IN ns | n.issueKey] AS path

MATCH p=(a:Issue)((x:Issue)-[r]-(y:Issue) WHERE r.linkId IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS{(x)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(u),(y)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(v) WHERE u<>v}){1,5}(b:Issue)
WHERE a.issueKey<b.issueKey
WITH p,a,b,nodes(p) AS ns
WHERE all(i IN range(0,size(ns)-1) WHERE all(j IN range(i+1,size(ns)-1) WHERE ns[i]<>ns[j]))
AND NOT EXISTS{(a)-[r2]-(n:Issue)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(q) WHERE r2.linkId IS NOT NULL AND NOT n IN ns AND NOT EXISTS{(a)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(q)}}
AND NOT EXISTS{(b)-[r3]-(m:Issue)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(q2) WHERE r3.linkId IS NOT NULL AND NOT m IN ns AND NOT EXISTS{(b)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(q2)}}
RETURN [n IN ns | n.issueKey] AS path, [e IN relationships(p) | e.linkId] AS links
